rationale: The agent did not follow policy. It performed order-changing writes (modify_pending_order_address on three orders) without first confirming with the user. There is no clear authentication beyond looking up a user by email, which is insufficient. The agent did not update the user’s default address at all, despite the request. It also selected and revealed a specific address without confirming that this was the intended “Washington DC address” referenced from an existing order, and it did not verify which orders were actually pending before applying changes. Finally, it provided no final confirmation or summary of actions. These issues violate the requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, act only on the user’s orders with proper verification, and complete the requested changes correctly.
